question: National Unity Day in India is observed on 31 October, coinciding with the birthday of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Unity Day or Rashtriya Ekta Diwas is celebrated on October 31 __every year.
 
• The day was introduced by the Government of India in 2014 to mark the birth anniversary of Iron Man of India - Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
 
• This year marks the 145th birth anniversary of the freedom fighter.
 
• Patel played a crucial role in India's freedom movement and in the integration of India from 560 princely states.
 
• He was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of independent India.
 
• National Unity Day is observed to acknowledge the efforts of Patel to unite the nation.
 
• The day aims to spread awareness about Patel's contribution to Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Dr. BR Ambedkar**

 
 
• The Centre has announced a public holiday on April 14__, 2021, on account of the birth anniversary of Dr BR Ambedkar.
 
• The Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions has declared in a notification that April 14 will be a public holiday for all central government offices including industrial establishments.
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**
 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was an Indian anti-colonial nationalist and the first Prime Minister of India.
 
• He was born on 14 November 1889 in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He died of a heart attack on 27 May 1964 in New Delhi.
 
• The Discovery of India and Glimpses of World History are two of his most famous works.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi****​**
 
 
• She was the second longest-serving Indian prime minister after her father Jawahar Lal Nehru.
 
• She was also awarded "Bangladesh Freedom Honour" in 2011.
 
• She was also the President of INC in 1959.
